headline: Congress named a Lakeland, Florida post office after a Marine corporal, Ronald R. Payne Jr.
what_it_does: This law renames the U.S. Postal Service facility at 6000 South Florida Avenue in Lakeland, Florida. The building will be called the U.S. Marine Corporal Ronald R. Payne Jr. Post Office. It does not change postal services, hours, or mail delivery.
when_it_takes_effect: The law was enacted on December 27, 2022, and the naming applies from that date.
